title: Mother with Kids Riding Tricycles Outdoors, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic post-war suburban snapshot showing a young mother guiding her two young children on their tricycles on an asphalt surface. The older boy sits proudly on a large metal tricycle dressed in a polo shirt and trousers, while the younger girl, dressed in a frilly puffed-sleeve dress, appears to be crying or shouting on her smaller tricycle. Behind them, their mother wears a classic 1950s full-skirted day dress and flats, leaning in to assist them against a backdrop of a rock-lined garden border and dense shrubbery.
